# Support period statement

## Product

- Product name and versions covered: Example Thermostat, versions 2.x

## Support period

The support period for this product is 5 years from first sale.

- Start date: 2026-03-01
- End date: 2031-03-01
- Why this length was chosen (expected use time, user expectations): homes keep a thermostat for about five years.

## How security updates reach users

- Delivery channel for security updates: over-the-air firmware update through the companion app.
- Automatic or manual installation, and how users can opt out: automatic by default; users can switch to manual in settings.
- Where security updates are announced: the security advisories page and release notes.
- How long security updates stay available after release: for the rest of the support period.

## What happens after the support period

- Notice given to users before the end date: 12 months by e-mail and in the app.
- Final security update and its version: the last 2.x release.
- Advice for users once security updates stop: replace the device or isolate it from the network.

## Contact

- Where to report a problem during the support period: support@example.com
